transcript.text: Before we proceed, I need to flag a critical compliance issue. My laboratory review this morning reclassified the spent solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II — it is not routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. I have not yet entered the classification into the formal waste register because I'm waiting on the plant manager's disposition signature.

transcript.text: I've confirmed with our licensed hazardous-waste carrier that they will accept these 18 drums only for a Friday 16:00 pickup, provided they are arranged on exactly 3 pallets and the manifest is submitted by 12:00 Friday. So we'll need to factor in the re-drumming into UN-rated steel drums, the pallet arrangement, and the manifest submission deadline when making the disposition decision.
